clips.title: The story
paras: At the High Rise bonfire, Zangen Stonehoof tends the flames and aids tauren kin across Kalimdor. Each evening, he keeps the central fire burning in Thunder Bluff.

Zangen Stonehoof tends the communal bonfire atop Thunder Bluff's High Rise. Each evening, as twilight falls over Mulgore, he lights the fire above the city's highest bluffs. The flames give warmth to the tribes gathered beneath High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. Zangen also keeps ties with allies beyond Mulgore's mesa, helping with spiritual and ritual work across the continent.

Zangen helps Rau Cliffrunner, who is stationed south in Thousand Needles. When Rau needed water from a night elf moonwell for sacred rituals, Zangen enlisted dependable Horde adventurers to cross the contested forests of Ashenvale. They secured a filled phial from the ancient groves and sent it south to Freewind Post. Zangen helps preserve ancient rites and support scattered tauren posts.
